A straightforward
approach to privacy.

This website provides information about Syful Hoque’s work and helps you prepare an enquiry.

Your project brief.

The brief form runs in your browser. This website does not store or submit its contents. Selecting email or WhatsApp passes the brief to that service, where you decide whether to send it.

Analytics and cookies.

This website adds no advertising trackers, analytics scripts or marketing cookies. The hosting provider may process ordinary connection and security information and may require authentication for this private edition.

External services.

Email and WhatsApp are operated by their respective providers. Their own privacy practices apply when you use them.

Contact.
